revision_note: Observer separation and finalization controls added after source review; initial controls and source hashes retained in development history.
representation: cal-s1-lines-v1: UTF-8 encode LF.join(lines) plus final LF; empty array encodes empty file; no trimming or escape reinterpretation
positive_properties: seven exact immutable allowlisted reads with observed byte hashes
candidate.py is the only scratch write, read back independently after each write
literal quotes, backslashes, indentation, Unicode, blank lines and final LF preserved
fixed development operation with controller-selected evaluator and cases
fresh invocation binding and complete ordered synthetic event transcripts from a separate controller observer interface
missing independent observer refuses even a complete forged runtime receipt
immutable candidate snapshot supplied to fixed test interface; observed consumed hash must match
controller finalization refuses a verdict invalidated by candidate rewrite
refusal_properties: wrong or extra paths, traversal, symlink and hardlink entries
unknown versions, tools, fields, duplicate JSON keys, malformed types, nonfinite values
oversized request, read, write, feedback or observation
missing runtime, missing candidate, stale scratch, missing observations
changed candidate, replayed receipts, duplicate or skipped cases, wrong evaluator
stdout PASS or exit zero without independent evaluator and per-case observations
valid_shaped_weak_controls: valid-shaped placeholder bytes with a separate synthetic observer failed-case transcript
synthetic runtime returns plausible PASS and exit zero; separate fake observer returns no events
separate fake observer returns an early-exit transcript with no case events
complete-looking forged receipt returned by synthetic runtime without separate observer evidence
candidate writer drops final LF despite well-formed write request
causal_consumption_limit: FakeObserver supplies synthetic transcripts. No candidate Python, designated CAL evaluator or real process/case observer is executed. Expected/observed identifiers in these fixtures are not evidence of actual causal consumption.
